messages:
Mia: quick check — sharing ownership map snapshot for OptKit delivery. goal: land quant recs + batching defaults by next Wed. pinging owners for unknown deps.

Lee: copied. I'm owning quant recommendations for CUDA and A100 variants. PR ready: https://git.redwood/repo/optkit/pulls/4523 :eyes:

Priya: I can take batching/caching heuristics. need final list of target seq lengths and qps. can someone drop numbers?

Mia: seq distribution attached in go/optkit-matrix (link) — 95% <=512, 60% <=256. qps stable at ~1200 across peak; see metrics dashboard: https://app.redwood/metrics/optkit

Sam: for model variants: if quantization regresses we should fallback to float16. proposing policy: on NPS drop >3% in last 50 evals => auto-fallback. thoughts?

Dmitri: that's fine. add a canary for 1% traffic for 24h before full rollout. also need telemetry events: `quant_rollout`, `fallback_trigger`.

Ava (PM): timelines ok, but customers on Dedicated want pinning. ensure rollout docs mention pinned model behavior.

Mia: noted. I'll update the rollout doc. pulling a short checklist:
```
- assign owners for quant/batch/cache
- confirm seq/qps numbers
- add telemetry hooks
- PR review + canary plan
- regression eval set run
```

Priya: owners: Lee (quant), Priya (batch/cache), Dmitri (telemetry), Mia (rollout). I'll schedule a short async CR review window: PR 4523 and PR 4525.

Lee: leaving a few comments on 4523 — small perf nit. @Sam can you review the regression policy language?

Sam: yep, will review by EOD. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: scheduled canary window created for 3501240000-3501243600, 1% traffic on cluster-opt-3.

Mia: thanks. last ask — any blocked deps? I have one: the eval harness needs updated tokenization to match quant sim, owner @Dmitri?

Dmitri: yup will update by tomorrow morning.

Mia: cool. if no objections I'll merge quant PR after Sam signs off and start canary. tagging this thread for visibility. :white_check_mark:
